ranking_label_caveat: Source-checked selected evidence spans, not an exhaustive human relevance pool. Valid alternative passages may be unlabelled; chunk-level numbers require adjudication before treating them as definitive retrieval accuracy.
review_provenance: Agent-reviewed provisional source labels, not human gold adjudication.
human_adjudication_needed: Alternative valid passages and exhaustive relevance coverage.

tuning: None; no threshold, source or label changes after model outputs.
publisher_content_storage: Full raw/extracted publisher copies and detailed outputs remain in local ignored artifacts/real-world/stage1; no vendor article bundles published.
timing_scope: Fresh local14B generation; retrieval diagnostics reused from actual six-strategy evaluation. Not a fresh full-pipeline latency benchmark.
stage_policy: No URLs beyond the first five ingested. Approval required before ten; current results do not justify expansion.
next_step: Adjudicate labels/scopes, improve candidate/context retrieval and atomic citation binding on separate development questions, then validate on new user questions.

synthetic_comparison.caveat: Different corpora, question authors, scopes and label coverage; descriptive comparison, not a controlled paired ablation.

reviewed_replay: Exact report equality from frozen annotations; no model call.
runtime_smoke: Fresh first-five CLI question about Ingress-controller necessity passed; not evidence that quality gates passed.
